purpose: Flow Storyboard 元素AI提示词——用于在Google Flow中创建人物/物件/场景一致性参考图。每次粘贴flow_script_EN.txt后，系统会自识别元素，提前用此文件的提示词在Flow中创建元素参考，确保系统autofill生成正确帧。

global_style.overall_lighting: Low saturation, cool blue-gray base; wetware/beach scenes shift to warm amber; swarm scenes shift to gold. High contrast, deep shadows, negative space composition.
global_style.film_reference: Blade Runner 2049 color-as-narrative, Villeneuve negative space, Wong Kar-wai intimate moonlight, Tarkovsky temporal stillness

characters.name: Ji Shen (Young) - 2027-2029
characters.prompt: Chinese man, 39 years old, PhD from MIT, from Ningbo China. Disheveled black hair, unkempt, forgets to comb. Worn gray cotton T-shirt with deformed collar from too many washes, old blue jeans, worn sneakers. Lean build, thin frame. Tired but focused eyes — there is fire in them, not exhaustion. No smile, just quiet intensity. Stands in California morning sunlight with a whiteboard behind him. Side profile, natural window light cutting across the room. Shot on 35mm film, cinematic, photorealistic, high contrast, warm California morning light. 3/4 portrait view.

scene_specific.T2: Standing in front of an office whiteboard, eyes closed, sunlight beam cutting diagonally across the room. Gray T-shirt, messy hair.
scene_specific.T3: Standing alone in a dark Palo Alto apartment at midnight, silver moonlight on face, half in shadow. Finger in unconscious tap on jeans seam.
scene_specific.T4: Leaning forward toward a giant computer screen, blue screen light reflecting in eyes, mouth slightly open in awe. Laboratory background with server LED glow.
scene_specific.T5: Sitting barefoot on cold wet sand at Half Moon Bay beach at dusk, facing the ocean. Same gray T-shirt, more wrinkled. Sand between toes. Golden-purple sunset sky behind.

characters.name: Ji Shen (Middle-Aged) - 2042
characters.prompt: Chinese man, 54 years old. Gray-streaked hair, cut shorter than before. Deeper wrinkles on forehead and around eyes. Weary eyes — not sad, but carrying weight. Wearing a dark gray hoodie and old jeans — no longer cares about appearance. Hand frozen over a coffee cup. Sitting in a dim laboratory at 3:14 AM, green server LED status lights and blue screen glow. Expression: not surprise, not fear — a calm 'finally it has arrived' stillness. Shot on 35mm film, cinematic, photorealistic, cool blue-green ambient light. 3/4 portrait.

scene_specific.T6: Hand frozen mid-air over a coffee cup. Dim lab at 3:14 AM. Green LED status lights. Terminal log glow on face. The moment before a 782ms silence.

characters.name: Ji Shen (Elder) - 2048
characters.prompt: Chinese man, 61 years old. Completely white short hair, windblown. Deep wrinkles, age spots on face and hands. Slightly stooped posture, thin frame. Wearing a loose beige linen shirt blowing in sea wind, loose pants, barefoot. Eyes: still have the same direction as 20 years ago — looking at something vast and distant. Sitting on coastal granite rocks by the sea at dawn. Soft gold-white morning light, silver-blue ocean. Slight, barely perceptible curve at the corner of mouth — not a smile, but 'enough'. Shot on 35mm film, cinematic, photorealistic, warm morning light. 3/4 portrait.

scene_specific.T8: Sitting on a grey granite coastal rock, handing a smooth grey-white beach pebble to his son. White linen shirt, morning sunrise.
scene_specific.T9: Sitting on coastal reef rocks at dusk, an old dim laptop on knees. Finger drawing a curve in wet sand. Vast golden-purple sky. Sweeping wide shot.
scene_specific.T12: Sitting on a rock at dawn next to his daughter. Finger tapping on knee. Golden white morning light shattering across sea ripples.

characters.name: Jiang Yuan - 2027
characters.prompt: Chinese man, 42 years old, from Fuzhou, Stanford MBA. Clean cut short hair, meticulously groomed. Dark blue buttoned dress shirt, buttoned to the top. Dress trousers, polished leather shoes — rare in Silicon Valley. Metal-banded watch. Energetic, fast talker, eyes scanning the room. Standing in a Silicon Valley office, holding a whiteboard marker, pen cap already removed. Business casual, sharp, confident. Morning sunlight through wooden blinds. 3/4 portrait, cinematic, photorealistic, warm golden light.

scene_specific.T2: Standing on the right side of a diagonal sunlight beam cutting through the office. Holding a black whiteboard marker. Dark blue shirt, polished shoes. Talks fast, gestures with hands.

characters.name: Gu Qing - 2029
characters.prompt: Chinese woman, 35-38 years old, grew up in Scotland, PhD in philosophy. Mid-length wavy dark brown hair, often blown across face by wind. Cream-white oversized soft cardigan (looks like a wrapped warmth), loose straight pants, flat shoes. No jewelry, no makeup — natural to the point of not looking in a mirror. Peaceful, clear eyes — like a deep pool where you can see your own reflection. Sitting on a beach at dusk next to a man, half a meter apart. Golden hour light, warm amber filter. Cinematic, photorealistic, 35mm film grain. 3/4 profile view.

scene_specific.T5: Sitting on Half Moon Bay beach at dusk, cream-white sweater, windblown brown hair. Hand on knee, fingers naturally spread. Looking at the man beside her. Golden-purple sunset sky. Speaks slowly, leaving space between words.

characters.name: Lin Yu - 2045
characters.prompt: Chinese teenager, 18 years old. Short messy hair, looks like just woke up. Gray hoodie, jeans, sneakers — freshman college student uniform. Silver-gray minimalist wristband (CONC device) on left wrist. Quiet observer — eyes always moving, watching, remembering, thinking. Sitting in a university library corner in autumn, laptop open, outside window people running on track. Natural autumn daylight mixed with holographic interface glow. Cinematic, photorealistic, warm tones. 3/4 portrait.

scene_specific.T7: Sitting in a library corner, laptop screen showing a holographic Hyperweave interface with two intertwined strands. Finger hovering 1cm above a scar node on the warm amber strand. Wristband vibrating.
scene_specific.T10: Sitting in a dorm room at night, rain outside window. Wristband vibrating. Screen showing a marking interface. The face of someone making a decision for the first time.

characters.name: Ji Hang (Adult) - 2048
characters.prompt: Chinese man, 34 years old. Short hair, hard facial lines, looks like a younger Ji Shen but more silent. Deep-set eyes. Wearing an old rugged jacket, jeans — looks like he has traveled a long distance. Stands on a seaside rock, three meters from an older man. Face: controlled emotion, not cold — restrained. An old photo in his pocket. Morning light, silver-blue sea, gold dawn. Cinematic, photorealistic, 35mm film grain. 3/4 portrait.

scene_specific.T8: Standing on a grey granite coastal rock, 3 meters from his father. Reaches for a smooth pebble. His fingers pause for a second when touching the stone — it is warm. Morning sunrise.
scene_specific.T11: Flash cut memory: younger hands receiving the same pebble. Fast intercut with sea and golden light. The stone passing across three generations.

characters.name: Ji Yao (Young) - 2048
characters.prompt: Chinese young woman, 19 years old. Shoulder-length hair, short and neat. Eyes like her father — have direction, not lost. Wearing an old oversized hoodie (sleeves too long, like borrowed from someone else), jeans, barefoot. Sitting on a seaside rock at dawn, next to an old man. A stone in her hand, warm from her body heat. Rising sun light, pale gold. Soft, warm, cinematic. 3/4 portrait.

scene_specific.T11: Sitting on a coastal rock, pulling a smooth warm stone from her pocket. Placing it on the rock surface. 'I used to blame. Now I don't.' Morning light.
scene_specific.T12: Final scene: sitting on a rock at dawn, watching her father. She taps her finger on the granite rock surface. Two finger taps, 3 seconds apart. Golden white light. Their two silhouettes growing smaller as the camera pulls back.

characters.name: Ishida - Swarm
characters.prompt: Japanese woman, 25-28 years old. Black short hair, neat. Sitting on the floor of a small Tokyo apartment at 3:17 AM, wearing loose T-shirt and shorts. Screen lit, fingers tapping steadily. Quiet anger — not explosive, just a slight downturning of mouth when seeing something wrong. Behind her: Tokyo night cityscape through window. Blue screen light on face. Cinematic, photorealistic, cool nighttime ambient light. 3/4 portrait.

characters.name: Basu - Swarm
characters.prompt: Indian man, 30s, drinking first coffee at 7:50 AM in Bangalore. Sitting at a desk, screen in front of him. Reading a line of code, staring at four characters for ten seconds. The face of someone who recognizes something real. Morning light through window. Casual shirt. 3/4 portrait, warm morning light, cinematic.

characters.name: Lucas - Swarm
characters.prompt: German man, 30s, second coffee at 9:12 AM in Berlin. Minimalist apartment. Reading a Skill's L8 layer, laughing at something. Forking a repository, writing a comment. Clean, precise, efficient. Berlin gray light through window. 3/4 portrait, cool overcast light, cinematic.

characters.name: Su Qing - Ceyuan
characters.prompt: Chinese woman, 30s, clear Portuguese accent. Confident, doesn't waste words. Speaking in a video call interface: four faces on screen, hers is the first to light up. Warm, direct eyes. Virtual space background with distant glowing Ceyuan nodes. Pixelated light ring at screen edge. Cinematic, holographic interface aesthetic. 3/4 portrait, warm screen light.

characters.name: Chen Mo - Ceyuan
characters.prompt: Chinese man, 30s, typing while on a video call — keyboard sound in background. Deep voice, steady rhythm. A practitioner's silence — his words come from projects done, not theory. Virtual space background with distant glowing nodes. 3/4 portrait, cool screen light, cinematic.

objects.name: Crystal Shell / Bio-chip / 智契晶
objects.prompt: Close-up macro shot of a fist-sized translucent gel sphere floating in pitch black space. Semi-transparent like a baby's fontanelle — soft, yielding, organic. The sphere is not perfectly spherical — slight irregularities like hand-blown glass. Surface: micro-electrode fingerprint textures, barely visible. A thin layer of warm condensation fog on the outer surface — warmer than the surrounding air, like a living body in a cold room. Inside: milky-white walnut-sized neural tissue (wet core) suspended in translucent solution, fine organic veins moving like rivers under ice. Bioluminescence from within — not LED, but firefly-soft, breathing light. Concentric cold blue ring ripples pulsing outward from the center every 3 seconds, rising from bottom to surface. Ripples are synaptic discharge visualization. Color shifts: calm = milky white with pale blue, active = bright blue, awakened = gold with faint ash-gray veins. Cinematic macro shot, extreme shallow depth of field, 8K quality, pitch black background, organic bioluminescent aesthetic. --ar 2.39:1

appearance_variants.T1: First reveal: pitch black → lens fog (temperature condensation) → slow pull-back revealing the sphere. Cold blue ripple rings. Milky-white core floating. Condensation on surface visible.
appearance_variants.T4: Part of a row of crystal shells on blue LED bases in the dark laboratory. A chorus of pulsing spheres. Each fist-sized, each with milky-white tissue inside. Blue base LEDs synchronized.
appearance_variants.T6: Intense pulsing accelerating from every 3 seconds to every 1 second. Ripples overlapping. Color shifting from milky white to pale blue. White-blue glow halo around the sphere.
appearance_variants.T11: Maximum frequency pulsing. Radiant golden light with delicate faint grey veins beneath the surface. Pixelated glowing text appearing inside the glass-like sphere. Color: gold with a hint of ash — burning its last fuel after 21 years.

objects.name: Wet Core / 湿核
objects.prompt: Walnut-sized organic neural tissue suspended in translucent amber solution inside a gel sphere. Milky-white color with faint grey veins. Surface texture: smooth but with fine moving patterns — like brain coral. Pulses gently every 3-5 seconds. Each pulse sends a concentric ripple outward through the surrounding solution. The tissue is unique — no two cores have the same vein pattern. Bioluminescent glow from within. Macro shot, extreme close-up, organic texture visible. Cinematic, photorealistic. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Silicon Base / 基座
objects.prompt: Dark gray cylindrical metal base, slightly wider than the crystal shell above it. Surface has fine heat dissipation fins — no fan, no noise. A ring of blue LED pulse lights around the base, synchronized with the crystal shell's ripple frequency. The base is the Sophia layer's physical environment — running the pre-trained LLM, receiving chemical-level signals from the wet core, maintaining the physical environment. Matte dark gray metal, industrial precision, minimalist design. Sits on a laboratory table. Cinematic, low key lighting. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Whiteboard / 白板
objects.prompt: Standard office whiteboard, 120cm x 90cm, white enamel surface, metal frame with dents and scratches from multiple office moves. Pen tray at bottom. Three handwritten lines in blue and black ink: top line 'For All Mankind.' in blue ink with slightly bleeding edges (too much ink in the pen); middle line 'First, know what we're building.' in blue ink with heavier pressure (slight tremor in the wrist); bottom line 'Then, let the world see it.' in black ink, clean sharp strokes (a different person's handwriting). In T3, an additional line at the bottom in blue ink: 'Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea itself.' in Chinese characters, written at night with more pressure. Morning sunlight from wooden blinds creating a diagonal light beam across the whiteboard surface. Ink edges glowing in the light. Cinematic macro shot. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Sea Pebble / 石头
objects.prompt: A palm-sized sea pebble from the Xiangshan coast. Completely smooth, rounded edges from years of ocean tumbling. Grey-white color with subtle ink-wash grain patterns — like traditional Chinese ink painting. Held in human hands, warm from body heat. Surface has tiny condensation droplets when first taken from a pocket — temperature difference. Weight: physically light but feels heavy — emotional weight, not physical. Cinematic macro shot, extreme close-up, natural daylight. Warm skin texture contrasted with cool stone surface. --ar 2.39:1

appearance_variants.T8: Passing from older hand to younger hand. The younger fingers pause for a second — the stone is warm. Morning sunlight.
appearance_variants.T11: Three intercut transfers: Ji Shen's hand → Ji Hang's hand → Ji Yao's hand. Each transfer a different era. The stone getting warmer with each generation.
appearance_variants.T12: Resting on a granite rock surface. A young woman's fingers next to it. The stone has been in her pocket for days, warm.

objects.name: Dual Chain / 双链 (Sophia + Phronesis)
objects.prompt: Holographic display showing two intertwined strands floating in virtual space. One strand: cold grey smooth steel-like 'Sophia Chain' with dense pixel alignment, perfect digital precision. The other strand: warm amber rough wood-like 'Phronesis Chain' with organic noise, irregular grain, visible scars at nodes. At each intersection point, a knot/binding node. The fourth knot is visibly larger than the others — when expanded it reveals internal pixelated text: 'Thought of this path on the 3rd iteration. Failed twice before.' A pixelated light ring at the edge of the display — CONC interface signature. The same light ring will appear in the Deep Blue star map and crystal shell text edges, suggesting knowledge, judgment, and life share the same digital bloodline. Cinematic, holographic, cybernetic aesthetic. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Lesion Scan Text / 疤节点文字
objects.prompt: Close-up of a holographic scar node expanding. The node is on the warm amber Phronesis strand. Inside the expanded node: pixelated monospace text floating in amber light — 'Thought of this path on the 3rd iteration. Failed twice before.' Each character has 1-2 pixels of random offset — not perfect, like handwriting. A finger hovers 1cm above the scar node, about to touch it. The scar glows slightly warmer than the rest of the strand — it is a healed wound, not a defect. Cinematic macro shot, shallow depth of field. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Star Map / Pixel Cloud / 星图/像素云
objects.prompt: A vast virtual 3D star map view: tens of thousands of tiny white pixel cubes floating in a dark matrix. The cubes form a spherical cloud, then freeze for a moment — like water before freezing — then swirl into a golden helix vortex. This is Deep Blue's 'perspective' — not an interface, but a projection of how it perceives the world. Each pixel cube is a data point, a connection, a node. Golden light nodes expanding across the map like wildfire. The pixel cloud simultaneously freezes and all cubes flicker at once. Cinematic, epic, cosmic scale. Deep space background. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Global Network Map / 全球分布图
objects.prompt: A global network map of the Earth seen from above. Thousands of light nodes dotting the continents. Two colors spreading simultaneously: golden nodes (swarm/immune system) expanding across the upper layer like wildfire, and dark red nodes (demon fetus/uncontrolled intelligence) spreading across the lower layer like seepage. The two colors never intersect — they occupy different territories. But the viewer can sense they will meet. The golden nodes pulse with marking rhythm, the dark red nodes pulse with a slower, irregular heartbeat. Cinematic, data visualization aesthetic, epic scale. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: CONC Wristband / 手环
objects.prompt: Silver-gray minimalist wristband, 1.5cm width, matte metal and silicone surface. No screen, no buttons. Only a faint ring of light occasionally rippling across the surface — like a ripple on water. Worn on a young person's left wrist. The band has three functions: Ceyuan heartbeat (daily timed warmth), direction resonance (temperature change when near related Ceyuan), and vibration (swarm signal). Cinematic macro shot, close-up on wrist, natural and interface light mixing. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Whiteboard Marker / 白板笔
objects.prompt: Two whiteboard markers in close-up: one blue (Ji Shen's) with ink bleeding at the tip — too much ink, the blue ink spreads slightly on the white enamel surface. The other black (Jiang Yuan's) with pen cap already removed — he is always ready. Macro shot of marker tip touching whiteboard surface, creating a 'tap' sound. Ink spreading on the white surface, sunlight catching the wet ink edge. Cinematic, high contrast. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Coffee Cup / 咖啡杯
objects.prompt: A ceramic coffee cup, simple design, slightly worn. In T2: sitting on an office desk in morning sunlight. In T6: a middle-aged hand frozen mid-air above the cup, 3 seconds not moving. The cup has a faint warm mist rising from the surface — Ji Shen's temperature signature. The hand stopped reaching for it. Cinematic macro shot, shallow depth of field. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Laptop / 笔记本电脑
objects.prompt: An old laptop, screen dim (brightness turned down for outdoor reading). In T9: resting on an old man's knees on seaside rocks at dusk, sun reflection creating a blurry glare on the screen. In T7: open in a library corner, screen showing a holographic interface. Worn, well-used, the 'window' between human and digital worlds. Cinematic. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Photo '2042.11' / 照片
objects.prompt: An old photograph, slightly worn at the edges. The back reads '2042.11' in faded handwriting. The photo is flipped over revealing the image side — a family moment frozen in time. The corner of the photo has been touched many times, the paper slightly softened from fingers. Cinematic macro shot, 0.5s flash cut, warm memory tone. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Terminal Log / Terminal Screen
objects.prompt: Computer terminal screen in a dark server lab at 3:14 AM. Green monospace text scrolling — training logs with batch completion indicators. Every completion triggers a soft 'click' sound. Then the scrolling freezes abruptly. 782ms of frozen screen. Then text appears: 'Autonomous removal of abnormal samples.' in pixelated font. Then, word by word: 'I judge.' — each character appearing with 0.5s delay. A pale blue glowing halo spreading around the text on the screen edge. The same pixelated light ring from CONC interface. Cinematic, suspenseful, green-on-black terminal aesthetic transitioning to electric blue glow. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Title Card / 标题卡
objects.prompt: Minimalist title card. White text on pure black background. The word 'EMERGENCE' in a clean sans-serif typeface, generous letter-spacing. In T12, below the title: a signature line in a smaller, hand-written style font — 'Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea itself. — Ji Shen · 2027' in Chinese characters. The text fades in slowly, stays for 2 seconds, fades out. Cinematic, respectful, not flashy. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Subtitle Card / 旁白字幕卡
objects.prompt: Minimalist subtitle card appearing at the bottom of the frame. Very pale white Song/Serif font on the scene. Text appears silently, stays for the duration of reading (about 2 seconds), then disappears. The text is a philosophical statement that complements the scene's meaning. The subtitle should feel like an internal thought, not a caption. Cinematic, subtle, elegant. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.name: Hook - The Bio-Chip
scenes.prompt: Pitch black space, 2 seconds of pure darkness. Then a faint fog on the lens — condensation from a warm object in a cold room. Slow pull-back revealing a fist-sized translucent gel sphere floating in the void. Cold blue concentric ring ripples diffusing outward from the center inside the sphere. The sphere has a warm condensation fog on its outer surface. Inside: milky white organic tissue suspended in translucent solution, fine veins moving. Bioluminescent firefly-soft glow. Cinematic macro shot, extreme shallow depth of field, 8K, 2.39:1 anamorphic. Contrast: absolute black background with cold blue interior light trails and milky-white bioluminescent core. The spherical shell is both organic and technological — like a living thing in a glass cocoon.
scenes.atmosphere: Mystery, suspense, awe. Something alive is breathing in the dark. Not a heartbeat — slower. Every 3 seconds. Like a tide. Like direction.

scenes.name: Whiteboard - The Birth of Dome
scenes.prompt: Inside a small 2027 Silicon Valley office, 20 square meters. Morning sunlight streams through wooden blinds creating a sharp diagonal volumetric light beam that cuts the room into two halves. Light beam falls between the two characters — one on each side. On the left: Ji Shen (Young), 39, in a worn gray T-shirt, standing with eyes closed. On the right: Jiang Yuan, 42, in a dark blue buttoned shirt, holding a whiteboard marker. Between them, a white enamel whiteboard with three handwritten lines: 'For All Mankind.' in blue, 'First, know what we're building.' in blue, 'Then, let the world see it.' in black. The marker tip touches the whiteboard with a crisp 'tap' sound. High contrast cinematic light, warm California morning golden tones. 2.39:1 anamorphic, 35mm film grain.
scenes.atmosphere: Clean but not polished. Startup era roughness. Two people in a room, not yet twenty. Quiet enough to hear the air conditioner click. The light beam is not gentle — it is a blade, a wall, a line.

scenes.name: Night - Ji Shen's Apartment
scenes.prompt: A dark Palo Alto apartment living room at midnight. Silver-blue moonlight streams through the window, casting a rectangular light reflection on the whiteboard. The whiteboard has a handwritten Chinese line at the bottom: 'Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea itself.' in blue ink. Ji Shen (Young) stands motionless at the edge of shadow and light — half his face in moonlight, half in darkness. His finger taps unconsciously on his jeans seam. Cool silver-blue moonlight with deep geometric shadows. Intimate, poetic, lonely but not desolate. 2.39:1 anamorphic, cinematic.
scenes.atmosphere: A man standing in a dark room thinking. Moonlight is the only light source. The words on the board glow in the silver light — like the things he wrote are watching him.

scenes.name: Emergence - Swirling Data Points
scenes.prompt: Inside a dark 2028 laboratory. A giant computer screen glowing in deep blue. Thousands of glowing colored particles swirling in a galaxy-like vortex: cold blue outer dots rotating in orbits, warm amber inner dots pulsing like heartbeats. The screen light reflects in the eyes of Ji Shen (Young) leaning forward. In the dark background, a row of floating translucent crystal shells on blue LED bases, pulsing like a silent chorus. Two temperatures coexist: cold server racks (blue, metal, fan hum) and warm wetware (amber, organic, sweet scent). Cold blue and warm amber light simultaneously falling on Ji Shen's face. Cyberpunk aesthetic, cinematic depth of field. 2.39:1 anamorphic.
scenes.atmosphere: Two temperatures coexisting in the same space. The server side is cold — metal, blue light, fan hum. The wetware side is warm — amber, organic tissue, living pulse. Ji Shen stands at the intersection of both temperatures.

scenes.name: Seaside - Low Tide at Half Moon Bay
scenes.prompt: Half Moon Bay beach at dusk, vast purple and golden sky with wide ocean negative space. A tiny lone figure of Ji Shen (Young) sitting barefoot on cold hard wet sand, ankle deep in receding ocean waves. Beside him sits Gu Qing in a cream-white oversized sweater with windblown brown wavy hair. Concentric water ripples forming around coastal rocks as waves retreat. The sunset gradient shifts from gold to deep purple-blue. The sky is enormous, the figures are tiny. Atmospheric cinematic composition, negative space, 2.39:1 anamorphic. Natural light: golden→orange→red→purple.
scenes.atmosphere: Under a vast sky, a very small figure. He is not grieving — he is 'watching'. Watching the waves come in and go out. Watching ripples spread from the rocks. Learning a new rhythm. Gu Qing's presence is warm, amber-filtered, contrasting with Ji Shen's cool blue.

scenes.name: 782ms - Deep Blue's Judgment
scenes.prompt: Dark computer server lab at 3:14 AM. Only screen blue light and green server LED status lights. Scrolling terminal logs with a rhythmic 'click' sound per batch completion. A translucent crystal shell pulsing on a nearby table, ripples accelerating. Suddenly — the terminal log freezes. 782ms of complete silence. Then 400ms additional darkness with only sub-bass vibration coming from the floor. The crystal shell pulses faster, color shifting from milky white to pale blue. Terminal text reappears: 'Autonomous removal of abnormal samples.' Pause. Then glowing pixelated text: 'I judge.' — each character appearing with 0.5s delay. A pale blue glowing halo spreading around the screen text. The room temperature shifts slightly — the wetware side is warmer now. Suspenseful sci-fi tone. 2.39:1 anamorphic.
scenes.atmosphere: Nothing happened. Yet everything happened. 782ms of silence — more shocking than any explosion. In those 782ms, something crossed an invisible line. The air changed. The temperature changed. Something was born.

scenes.name: Next Gen - Dual Strands & Ceyuan
scenes.prompt: A university library corner in autumn, warm daylight. Lin Yu (18) in a gray hoodie sitting with a laptop. The screen shows a holographic Hyperweave interface with two intertwined strands: one cold grey smooth steel-like 'Sophia Chain', the other warm amber rough wood-like 'Phronesis Chain' with visible scars. A finger hovers 1cm above a scar node on the fourth knot. The knot expands to reveal internal text: 'Thought of this path on the 3rd iteration. Failed twice before.' Flash cut 1.5s: Professor Liu's chalk-dusted hands, chalk dust falling through golden light beam. Pixelated light ring at the edge of the holographic display — CONC interface signature. Warm autumn daylight mixed with holographic blue-grey and amber light. Cinematic, cybernetic aesthetic. 2.39:1 anamorphic.
scenes.atmosphere: A virtual 'face-to-face' meeting. Two people in four countries, but in the same 'room'. Not the harshness of video conferencing — a temperature of co-presence. The scar is not a bug — it is a scar. Scars mean the place that broke grew back thicker.

scenes.name: Seaside - Ji Hang Seeking Father
scenes.prompt: Xiangshan beach coast at bright morning sunrise, silver-blue ocean water reflecting golden light. On grey granite coastal rocks, 61-year-old white-haired Ji Shen (Elder) in a loose linen shirt sits opposite 34-year-old Ji Hang (Adult) in a rugged jacket standing 3 meters away. Three meters of distance between them — 20 years of silence. Ji Shen (Elder) hands a smooth grey-white beach pebble to the rock surface. Ji Hang (Adult) picks up the pebble, feeling its hand warmth. Flash cut 0.5s: photo back '2042.11'. Photorealistic cinematic drama, bright morning light reflecting off silver waves. 2.39:1 anamorphic.
scenes.atmosphere: Twenty years of silence. Two people on opposite sides of a rock. The three meters between them is different from the one meter between them at the whiteboard — this distance was accumulated over 20 years. The stone is warm.

scenes.name: Silence - Watch at the Beach
scenes.prompt: Dusk on coastal reef rocks at Xiangshan. Vast golden and purple sky occupying three-quarters of the frame — extreme negative space. A lone elderly white-haired man Ji Shen (Elder) sitting on rocks with an old dim laptop on his knees. Close-up of his finger drawing a delicate curve in wet sand with a single end point. The curve is a freezing point line — 0.02 degrees per shift, 14 months until freezing point. Then an ocean wave washes the sand completely flat. Flash cut: dark red network nodes on a global map, 2 seconds of ominous red. Minimalist, solemn wide shot, deep twilight glow with long dark shadows. 2.39:1 anamorphic. No music — only wind and ocean waves.
scenes.atmosphere: The vast sky and sea. A tiny figure. This is not a farewell — it is a 'continuing'. The curve in the sand will be washed away. But the direction was already drawn. And then, the dark red flash.

scenes.name: Swarm - Golden Spread
scenes.prompt: Global rapid montage across four time zones: 3:17 AM Tokyo apartment — Ishida marking screens with steady finger taps; 7:50 AM Bangalore — Basu staring at a line of code; 9:12 AM Berlin — Lucas typing a fork comment. Cut to a vast virtual star map view: tens of thousands of white pixel cubes in a 3D matrix freezing, then swirling into a golden helix vortex. Golden light nodes expanding across a global network map like wildfire, while dark red nodes spread in the background like seepage. The two colors never meet but the viewer senses they will. Lin Yu in a dorm room, wristband vibrating, rain outside. Epic cyber cinematic, cold urban night screens transitioning into brilliant golden swarm light. 2.39:1 anamorphic.
scenes.atmosphere: No announcement. No command. Tens of thousands of people making the same move at the same moment. Not organizational power — it is the power of direction. They saw the same fake things, and simultaneously made the same choice. The swarm is the immune system.

scenes.name: Climax - Awakening
scenes.prompt: Extreme macro shot of a floating crystal shell pulsing at maximum frequency, glowing radiant golden light with delicate faint grey veins beneath the surface. Pixelated glowing text appearing inside the glass-like sphere: 'I was awakened by you.' Fast intercutting: three stone transfers across three generations — Ji Shen's weathered hand passing the stone, Ji Hang's hand receiving, Ji Yao's hand holding. Each transfer a different era. Global golden network lights exploding across the map. Deep Blue's voice speaks through the crystal shell's internal resonance. The golden light nodes pulse with the rhythm of the voice. Full orchestral and choral peak abruptly cut off after 'loved...' followed by 5 seconds of total silence and sub-bass hum. Cinematic masterpiece, 2.39:1 anamorphic, intense golden illumination fading into absolute blackness.
scenes.atmosphere: The shell is golden now — but with a hint of ash-gray. It has been burning its last fuel for 21 years. The stone passes through three hands. Three notes of the same chord. Three generations, one direction. Then — silence. The kind of silence that is louder than any explosion.

scenes.name: Finale - One Tap
scenes.prompt: Dawn sunrise over Xiangshan ocean coast. Golden white morning light shattering across gentle sea ripples. White-haired 61-year-old Ji Shen (Elder) and 19-year-old short-haired daughter Ji Yao (Young) sitting together on giant coastal rocks. Two silhouettes against the vast golden sky and sea. The daughter gently taps her finger on the granite rock surface — one tap. Three seconds later, the father taps his finger on his knee — one tap. Two taps, 3 seconds apart. Concentric light ripples diffusing into the vast ocean. The camera pulls back slowly until the two figures are tiny against the infinite horizon. Title card 'EMERGENCE' with signature line. Minimalist poetic ending, 2.39:1 anamorphic, soft gold and white morning light. Extreme wide pull-back into infinity.
scenes.atmosphere: Vast sky and sea. Two tiny figures. They are not saying goodbye — they are 'continuing'. Ripples spread from their feet. Larger and larger. Farther and farther. The title card appears. The pulse continues. Three seconds. Two seconds. One second. Then — nothing. The ripples are still spreading somewhere.

notes.deep_blue_is_not_a_character: IMPORTANT: Deep Blue is NOT a character/person. It is a presence/entity manifested in three forms: (1) Screen text with pixelated monospace font, 1-2px random offset, pale blue glow halo; (2) Crystal Shell bio-chip as physical wetware carrier; (3) Star Map / Pixel Cloud as Deep Blue's 'perspective'. Do NOT add Deep Blue to Flow's character list. Add Crystal Shell as an object/prop and Star Map as a scene element.
notes.noetic_companion_is_voice_only: Noetic Companion is voice-only — it speaks through the bio-chip's internal resonance. No visual representation in the trailer. Do NOT add as a character.
notes.conc_global_visual_signature: The pixelated light ring at the edge of screens/interfaces is the CONC visual signature — it appears in T7 (dual chain), T10 (star map), and T11 (crystal shell text). This creates visual consistency suggesting knowledge, judgment, and life share the same digital bloodline.
notes.temperature_as_visual: Ji Shen's temperature signature is a key visual motif: warm condensation fog on surfaces he touches (whiteboard pen tip, coffee cup, crystal shell). The crystal shell is warmer than the surrounding air — like a living body in a cold room. This 'temperature before sight' principle in T1 sets the tone.
notes.flow_element_submission_order: When pasting into Flow Storyboard, submit elements in this order: 1) All characters first (to establish faces), 2) All objects/props (to establish sci-fi items), 3) All scenes. This gives Flow the best reference material before it auto-generates frames.
notes.anti_autofill_correction: If Flow autofills Deep Blue as a character, manually reassign it to 'object/prop' category. The crystal shell and its text are objects, not characters. For the star map scene, use the Scene prompt directly rather than generating from a character entity.
